updates.content:
been thinking more about why anakin actually sticks as a meme compared to the usual one-week stuff

the character already has the full cycle built in. he starts with belief, gets used by people who pretend to care, loses the future he thought he was protecting, and then turns. you don’t need to force a caption onto it every time because the scenes themselves already do the work

that’s why it travels in different formats without dying. one post can be the family image as the stolen future, the next can be the council scene as the out of touch people running things, the next can be the turn as the moment people stop playing nice. same character, different angle

it reminds me of how pepe went from a random frog to something people actually attached meaning to, or how pnut became more than just the squirrel once the event hit. both got used because the base image could carry whatever people were already feeling. anakin does the same thing except the source material already has the betrayal and the lost future baked in

other tokens that started more political or narrative-driven like boden or the early tremp ones had heat for a bit but they were mostly tied to the moment. this one has more room to keep being reused after the news cycle moves on because the frustration it maps onto doesn’t disappear when an election ends

also makes sense why elon would gravitate toward it. the character is high status, competent, and gets screwed by institutions that claim to be the good guys. that lines up with how he already talks about systems, legacy media, and people in power not delivering what they promised. the family image version especially fits the “this is what they took” framing he’s used before

still early and still messy on-chain but the template itself is one of the cleaner ones we’ve had in a while
